terms.gloss: resort to, have recourse to, take refuge in
evidence: Cic. Lig. 30: ad clēmentiam tuam (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Literally to flee for refuge; figuratively, and often in Cicero, to fall back on a means: entreaties, someone’s mercy, philosophy.

phrases.latin: Cum nihil aliud prōdesset, ad precēs cōnfūgit.
phrases.english: When nothing else worked, he resorted to begging.
